title: Delhi BJP Mahila Morcha protests outside Congress HQ
seoTitle: Delhi BJP women protest Congress HQ

tea.why: Protesters alleged that Congress leaders misbehaved with women police personnel during earlier demonstrations.
tea.want: They demanded a public apology from Congress MP Rahul Gandhi and the Congress party.
tea.changed: Oct 8, 2026: The Delhi BJP Mahila Morcha staged a protest near the Congress headquarters and later held a sit-in after being stopped by police.

summary: On October 8, 2026, the Delhi unit of the Bharatiya Janata Party's (BJP) Mahila Morcha organised a protest march near the Congress headquarters in New Delhi. Led by figures including Delhi BJP general secretary Yogita Singh, Aarti Mehra, and Archana Gupta, the demonstrators raised slogans and demanded a public apology from Congress MP Rahul Gandhi. The protest followed allegations that Congress leaders had misbehaved with women police personnel during previous demonstrations on Tuesday and Wednesday. Police established a heavy human barricade near Hindi Bhawan and forcibly stopped the marching participants, who then staged a sit-in before being warned and allowed to leave.
demands: A public apology from Congress MP Rahul Gandhi
An apology from the Congress party for alleged disrespect toward women police personnel
response: Police formed a heavy human barricade near Hindi Bhawan, forcibly stopped the protest march, and later issued a warning before allowing the participants to leave, according to reports.

updates.text: The Delhi BJP Mahila Morcha staged a protest near the Congress headquarters, alleging misconduct against women police personnel by Rahul Gandhi.
Police blocked the march with a heavy barricade near Hindi Bhawan, leading to a temporary sit-in by protesters before they dispersed.
